p: likeness of God made he him: Read Ge 1:26.
Adam: By giving them both one name, he notes the inseparable conjunction of man and wife.
likeness: As well, concerning his creation, as his corruption.

Seth lived an hundred and five: He proves Adam's generation by those who came from Seth, to show the true Church, and also what care God had over the same from the beginning, in that he continued his graces toward it by a continual succession.

nine hundred and twelve years: The main reason for long life in the first age, was the multiplication of mankind, that according to God's commandment at the beginning the world might be filled with people, who would universally praise him.
walked with God after he begat: That is, he led an upright and godly life.
God took him: To show that there was a better life prepared and to be a testimony of the immortality of souls and bodies. To inquire where he went is mere curiosity.

comfort us concerning our work and: Lamech had respect for the promise, Ge 3:15, and desired to see the deliverer who would be sent and yet saw but a figure of it. He spoke this by the spirit of prophecy because Noah delivered the Church and preserved it by his obedience.
